description: This file contains the implementation of the MembershipTableCleanupAgent class, which handles cleanup of dead membership entries in the Orleans clustering system. It manages scheduling cleanup tasks, executing cleanup operations, and participating in lifecycle and health check interfaces.

classes.name: MembershipTableCleanupAgent
classes.description: Handles scheduled cleanup of defunct silo entries in the Orleans membership table, integrating with lifecycle and health check interfaces.

methods.name: MembershipTableCleanupAgent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cleanup agent with configuration options, membership table provider, logger, and creation of cleanup timer if configured.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the cleanup timer, stopping scheduled cleanup tasks.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSilos
methods.description: Performs cleanup of defunct silo entries periodically based on configured interval.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to the silo lifecycle to start and stop the cleanup process.
